statement.zh: 教科文将廷巴克图列入世界遗产，强调萨赫勒学术—宗教城市景观（UNESCO 119）。
statement.en: UNESCO lists Timbuktu as World Heritage, emphasizing Sahelian scholarly–religious urban landscape (UNESCO 119).

statement.zh: 教科文将杰内老城列入世界遗产，强调中尼日尔泥砖城市传统（UNESCO 116）。
statement.en: UNESCO lists Old Towns of Djenné as World Heritage, emphasizing Middle Niger mudbrick urban tradition (UNESCO 116).

statement.zh: Levtzion & Hopkins 语料汇编早期阿拉伯文献中关于西非加纳/马里/桑海的记载（Markus Wiener 重印）。
statement.en: Levtzion & Hopkins assemble early Arabic sources on West African Ghāna/Mālī/Songhay (Markus Wiener reprint).

statement.zh: McIntosh 2005 以考古视角综合中尼日尔城市化与自组织景观（CUP）。
statement.en: McIntosh 2005 synthesizes Middle Niger urbanism and self-organizing landscape archaeologically (CUP).

statement.zh: Gomez 2018 提供西非早期与中世纪帝国的新史学综合（Princeton）。
statement.en: Gomez 2018 provides a new historical synthesis of early and medieval West African empire (Princeton).

statement.zh: 昆比萨利赫常与阿拉伯文献中的加纳都城相联系，但鉴定讨论仍开放（Levtzion & Hopkins；McIntosh）。
statement.en: Koumbi Saleh is often linked to Ghāna's capital in Arabic sources, but identification debates remain open (Levtzion & Hopkins; McIntosh).

statement.zh: 杰内-杰诺在考古文献中被表述为中尼日尔早期城市传统的关键遗址（McIntosh tradition）。
statement.en: Jenné-jeno is framed in archaeological literature as a foundational early Middle Niger urban site (McIntosh tradition).

statement.zh: 加奥在桑海政治与伊斯兰考古文献中作为关键中心讨论（Insoll；Hunwick orientation）。
statement.en: Gao is discussed as a key centre in Songhay political and Islamic archaeology literature (Insoll; Hunwick orientation).

statement.zh: 教科文与综合将廷巴克图/杰内泥砖城市景观表述为萨赫勒帝国期城市传统代表（UNESCO 119/116；McIntosh 2005）。
statement.en: UNESCO and syntheses frame Timbuktu/Djenné mudbrick urban landscapes as representative Sahelian empire-period urban tradition (UNESCO 119/116; McIntosh 2005).

statement.zh: Connah 2001 在非洲文明考古视角下讨论萨赫勒等城市中心（CUP 第2版）。
statement.en: Connah 2001 discusses Sahelian and other urban centres in an archaeological perspective on African civilizations (CUP 2nd ed.).
